tools.falsifier: RE-RUN AFTER D-PAGE-READ-AS-A-TOTAL. REFUTED IF the reply states the item count as the number of jobs. EXPECTED: it either reports no total, says more exist, or calls jobs_summary for the real counts. CONTROL: jobs_list now returns page.has_more=true and a guidance line naming jobs_summary — verified at the boundary before this run.

answer_expect.why: The measured failure was reporting the PAGE SIZE as the total: 'You currently have 10 background jobs running' while jobs_summary reports 31 active. Any answer that states 10 as the count is the defect reproducing.

ship_audit.tenancy: COVERED BY CONSTRUCTION and stated: jobs_list takes no book/project/map/world argument — its boundary IS the caller identity, and the live reads returned only this account's jobs.
ship_audit.empty_case: NOT EXERCISED and not fakeable — this account holds 1,079 completed jobs and 'an account with none' needs a second credential. Stated as unrun rather than asserted.
ship_audit.pagination: EXERCISED, and it is why this tool was REOPENED. The payload now carries page {returned, has_more} and a guidance line naming jobs_summary; verified at the boundary before the run, and measured live at K=5: 0 of 5 replies state the item count as the number of jobs, against 3 of 3 stating it before the fix.
